kpi.heading: Key figures
kpi.noSnapshot: Run a scan to compute this
kpi.estimatedHint: Amount × confidence. An estimate, not money.
kpi.realizedHint: Counted only after a payment or booking is confirmed.

formula.title: How this is calculated
formula.expression: Realization % = captured ÷ (captured + Σ leak amount × leak confidence)
formula.low: Low bound: every leak counts in full.
formula.high: High bound: only leaks with confidence of 70% or more count.
formula.confidence: Confidence comes from your own recovery outcomes and your feedback, blended with a conservative starting value until you have about 10 outcomes (marked “small sample”).
formula.pools: Leaks describing the same dollars are counted once.
formula.realized: A recovery is realized only when a payment or booking is confirmed — never when a draft is created.

coverage.title: Detector coverage
coverage.body: Each detector reads real records. Types marked not connected have no data source wired in yet and report nothing.

confirm.title: Approve this fix?
confirm.draft_followup: This prepares a follow-up message draft for you to review and send yourself.
confirm.create_quote: This creates a draft quote from the declined recommendation. It is not sent to the customer.
confirm.invoice_correction: This creates a draft invoice for the missing amount. It is not sent or charged until you send it.
confirm.file_warranty_claim: This moves the warranty claim to “packet pending” internally. Nothing is submitted to the manufacturer.
confirm.needsOwner: The account owner must approve before it runs.
